turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello! Thank you for contacting us today. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I seem to be missing credits from my account

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It was from a one time deal due to a previous purchase

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Oh no! I'm sorry to hear that. Let's see if we can resolve that. Can I have your name please?

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Chloe Zhang.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A reason of previous purchase has been recorded.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay let me see what's going on. One second.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you know how much the credit was supposed to be for?

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A promo code has been created.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay it does look like it was an error in our system. I have generated a promo code for the missing credit. Here you go: UQ75U.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I help you with anything else today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you and have a great day!
